style: 雾港·第九区 night harbour city: indigo/violet base, magenta/cyan/amber neon, fog near the ground
coordinates: Each layer is a camera-facing plane parallel to the car side, `depthM` metres from the eye. Heights are metres relative to the EYE (street = -eyeAboveStreetM). Image row 0 = yTopM, last row = yBottomM. One image repeats every tileWidthM metres horizontally (wrapS = RepeatWrapping; seamless).
motion: Keep the planes fixed relative to the car and scroll the texture: offset.x = carDistanceM / tileWidthM (mod 1). That gives screen speed = carSpeed / depthM, i.e. parallax proportional to 1/depth. speedFactor is the same thing normalised to the fastest (close) layer.
render: Draw back to front (sky first). MeshBasicMaterial({map, transparent: alpha, depthWrite:false, fog:false, toneMapped:false}); texture.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace; generate mipmaps; anisotropy 4-8. The last row of every layer is fog/street colour: extend the plane below yBottomM (or clear to bottomColor) if the view can look lower. Neon pixels are near 1.0 and will catch bloom; scale the colour down (e.g. 0.85) if bloom gets too hot.
